meta.title: Aster — Native macOS terminal workspace
meta.description: Aster is an open-source, native macOS terminal workspace: the Ghostty terminal core, recursive splits, file previews, AI agent sessions and on-device completion in one AppKit window. macOS 14+ (Apple silicon), MIT licensed, no usage data collected.
meta.ogImageAlt: Aster Terminal: a native macOS workspace of terminals, files and previews

text.原生 macOS 14+ · AppKit · Ghostty 内核: Native on macOS 14+ · AppKit · Ghostty core
text.Aster 是开源的原生 macOS 终端工作区。终端、文件预览、AI Agen: Aster is an open-source, native macOS terminal workspace. Terminals, file previews, AI agent sessions and on-device completion share one window, so your train of thought keeps moving.
text.交互示例，不执行真实命令。也可以点击候选项试试。: Interactive example; no real commands are run. Try clicking a suggestion, too.
text.命令在跑，文档在旁边。每一块上下文，都有恰好的位置。: Commands run, docs sit alongside. Every piece of context has its place.
text.终端与 Markdown 文档，在同一个原生窗口里。: Terminal and Markdown docs in one native window.
text.思路不用停下来。: no break in your train of thought.
text.714 份 Fig 命令规格、文件与别名候选、隐私感知学习。补全全部发生在本机，: 714 Fig command specs, file and alias candidates, privacy-aware learning. Completion happens entirely on your Mac, never through a server.
text.Claude Code、Codex 会话自动获得标题与运行状态，标签栏一眼看到谁: Claude Code and Codex sessions get titles and run states automatically, so the tab bar shows who's thinking; transcripts replay right in the File Pane.
text.源码、Markdown、图片、PDF、diff、hex，一个 File Pane: Source, Markdown, images, PDF, diff and hex all open in one File Pane; split recursively in any direction and mix terminals with previews.
text.实时终端预览，无需重启；明暗外观可分开指定。: Live terminal preview, no restart; light and dark appearances are set separately.
text.Linux 服务器或 OrbStack 虚拟机的终端与布局跑在远端后台服务里，关: Terminals and layouts on Linux servers or OrbStack VMs run in a background service on the remote host and keep going after you quit Aster. After an SSH login, the right panel switches to server files and monitoring, reusing the authenticated connection.
text.Sparkle 2 后台检查，更新必须同时通过 EdDSA 签名与公证校验；不收: Sparkle 2 checks in the background, and every update must pass both EdDSA signature and notarization checks. No usage data is collected, and networked features such as crash reporting are off by default.
text.六种界面语言，跟随系统或手动指定: Six interface languages, following the system or set by hand
text..asterrecipe 导出整个工作区，启动即恢复: .asterrecipe exports the whole workspace, restored on launch
text.和传统终端，差在整个工作区。: Versus traditional terminals, the difference is the whole workspace.
text.差异不在快慢，在于哪些事不用再离开这个窗口。: It isn't about speed. It's about what you no longer have to leave this window for.
text.cat / less，或切去编辑器和 Finder: cat / less, or switch to an editor and Finder
text.File Pane 同窗预览源码、Markdown、图片、PDF、diff、he: File Pane previews source, Markdown, images, PDF, diff and hex in the same window
text.输出滚过就没了，哪个会话在干活全靠盯: Output scrolls away; you have to keep watching to know which session is working
text.Claude Code、Codex 会话自动命名，标签栏显示运行状态，trans: Claude Code and Codex sessions are named automatically, run state shows in the tab bar, transcripts can be replayed
text.自己攒 fzf、zsh-autosuggestions 一套插件: Assemble your own fzf and zsh-autosuggestions plugin stack
text.开箱内置 714 份命令规格 + 文件/别名候选，本机隐私学习: 714 command specs plus file/alias candidates built in, private on-device learning
text.布局与会话多数关窗即失，或靠手写脚本: Layouts and sessions mostly vanish with the window, or depend on hand-written scripts
text..asterrecipe 一个文件导出整个工作区，启动即恢复: .asterrecipe exports the whole workspace to one file, restored on launch
text.ssh 进去只有一个 Shell，文件和监控另开工具: ssh gives you a single shell; files and monitoring need other tools
text.远端终端与布局常驻后台服务，右侧面板直接看服务器文件与负载: Remote terminals and layouts live in a background service; the right panel shows server files and load directly
text.Electron / 跨平台框架的不在少数: Quite a few are built on Electron or cross-platform frameworks
text.纯 AppKit 原生 + Ghostty 终端内核，不收集使用数据: Pure native AppKit plus the Ghostty terminal core; no usage data collected
text.到 GitHub 说说你的体验: Tell us how it went on GitHub
text.我的 Mac 能用 Aster 吗？: Will Aster run on my Mac?
text.Aster 需要 macOS 14 Sonoma 或更高版本。当前发布的安装包只: Aster requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Current releases ship only the Apple silicon (arm64) build, so Intel Macs can't run it.
text.免费。Aster 以 MIT 许可证开源，已签名并公证的 DMG 安装包和全部源: Yes. Aster is open source under the MIT license; the signed, notarized DMG and all of the source code are free on GitHub, with no account required.
text.Aster 和 iTerm2、Warp 等终端有什么不同？: How is Aster different from terminals like iTerm2 or Warp?
text.Aster 是一个以 AppKit 构建的原生工作区：基于 Ghostty 内核: Aster is a native workspace built with AppKit: a terminal on the Ghostty core shares one window with file browsers, editors and previews in recursive splits. It also shows titles and status for agent sessions such as Claude Code and Codex, offers on-device completion with 714 command specs, and keeps workspaces you can export as .asterrecipe and restore at launch.
text.Aster 支持远程服务器和 SSH 吗？: Does Aster support remote servers and SSH?
text.支持。你可以在“设置 ▸ 主机”保存 SSH 主机并直接打开原生 SSH 标签，: Yes. Save SSH hosts under “Settings ▸ Host” and open native SSH tabs directly; passwords live only in the macOS Keychain. You can also add Linux servers and similar machines as remote machines: terminals run in a background session service on the remote host, so processes and layouts survive quitting Aster or losing the network.
text.Aster 不收集使用数据：补全、学习和常用目录排名都只在本机进行，更新检查也不: Aster does not collect usage data. Completion, learning and frequent-directory ranking all happen on your Mac, and update checks send no usage data or system information. Features that send content over the network, such as crash reports or distilling project memory with a CLI agent, are off by default and only work after you turn them on in Settings.
text.Aster 内置 Sparkle 2，默认每天在后台检查一次官方更新源，也可以用: Aster has Sparkle 2 built in. By default it checks the official update feed once a day in the background, and you can check manually with “Aster ▸ Check for Updates…”. A package is installed only after it passes both EdDSA signature and macOS notarization checks. Version 0.4.1 and earlier have no updater, so download the new DMG manually once.
text.macOS 14+ · Apple 芯片 · 免费开源: macOS 14+ · Apple silicon · Free & open source
text.原生 macOS 终端工作区。不收集使用数据，联网功能默认关闭。: A native macOS terminal workspace. No usage data collected; networked features are off by default.
text.终端、文件、Agent、SSH 与主题可以组成你的工作区: Terminals, files, agents, SSH and themes make up your workspace
text.Aster 实际窗口：左侧标签栏、中间终端、右侧 Markdown 预览: Actual Aster window: tab bar on the left, terminal in the middle, Markdown preview on the right

text.从一个具体任务开始，组合你需要的终端、文件和预览。: Start with a task and combine the terminals, files, and previews you need.
text.以下是根据已发布功能编写的工作流示例，不是用户评价或真实人物引言。: These workflow examples describe released features. They are not user reviews or quotes from real people.
text.在终端旁打开 README，运行命令时同时阅读项目文档。: Open a README beside the terminal and read project documentation while running commands.
text.并排运行 Claude Code 或 Codex，通过会话标题和运行状态区分各个: Run Claude Code or Codex side by side and distinguish tasks by their session titles and running status.
text.用递归分屏把终端、文件浏览器、编辑器和预览排在同一个 AppKit 窗口里。: Arrange terminals, a file browser, an editor, and previews in recursive splits within one AppKit window.
text.连接 SSH 后，在详情面板查看服务器文件、进程和监听端口。: After connecting over SSH, inspect server files, processes, and listening ports in the details panel.
text.使用远程机器工作区，在服务器会话服务中保留进程和布局，重新连接后继续工作。: Use a remote machine workspace to keep processes and layouts in the server-side session service and continue after reconnecting.
text.运行多个 Agent 时查看标签状态，并通过完成通知了解任务进展。: Check tab status while multiple agents run, and use completion notifications to follow task progress.
text.用内置命令规格补全 git、docker 和 kubectl 的子命令与参数。: Use built-in command specs to complete subcommands and arguments for git, docker, and kubectl.
text.输入命令后查看补全候选，用 Tab 接受合适的建议。: Inspect completion candidates as you type a command and accept a suitable suggestion with Tab.
text.把项目的分屏、目录和文件保存成 .asterrecipe，需要时重新打开。: Save a project’s splits, directories, and files as an .asterrecipe and reopen it when needed.
text.编辑 Markdown 时把渲染预览放在旁边，同时检查源码和排版。: Place a rendered preview beside your Markdown editor to check both source and formatting.
text.在设置中预览 24 套内置主题，并分别设置明暗外观。: Preview the 24 built-in themes in Settings and configure light and dark appearances separately.
text.用颜色区分标签；临时运行命令时，通过快捷键打开 Quick Terminal。: Distinguish tabs by color and open Quick Terminal with a shortcut for a temporary command.
text.，欢迎提供可复现的问题和具体工作流反馈。: — Reproducible issues and specific workflow feedback are welcome.
